digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate / bug-fix review tier escalation + Gerrit DET criterion
propositions: Complex bug fixes with non-test file_impact must escalate from light advisory tier to full blocking LLM rubric, determined by persisted ticket state at review time, covering both precheck and route_criteria seams and batch-runner fan-in without CLI flags or schema changes

Gerrit DET criterion blocks oversized bug fixes (>150 non-test lines) lacking current or code-drifted plan-review attestation by verifying cross-host op-cert signatures via opcert_from_record, trusted_env_keyring, and compute_validity freshness checks

Attestation verdict classification must accept certified/stale-code/stale-head, flag remaining compute_validity plan-review-reachable literals and op-cert verification failures {mismatch, key_not_valid_at_era, unknown_kind, unknown_scheme, invalid}, and fail-open only on infrastructure errors {unavailable, error, unknown-future}
Non-test line classification rule (tests/** and conftest.py excluded) and 150-line threshold must be stated as a single shared constant used by both B2 criterion and backtest validation
Backtest over 113 historical bug-fix commits must flag exactly the 13 hand-adjudicated substantive commits with >150 non-test lines and zero false positives from mechanical changes
Claim-time bug exemption from plan-review gate remains intact and unchanged
